title: Function Health header
description: A solid terracotta announcement strip, then a rounded 80px nav bar floating over the top of the page: glass with light text over a photo hero, melting into a transparent bar with terracotta text and a solid pill once you scroll past it. Wordmark left, centred links, Log in, pill, search and menu icons; on phones only the wordmark, pill and icons. The menu icon opens a rounded panel of all links.
notes: sits over the hero: the nav wrapper has zero height, so put the hero straight after it
the glass state assumes a dark photo behind the bar; it switches to the solid state after scrolling `solidAfter` × window height
the sticky wrapper needs a tall parent: render the block and the page in the same container
name: functionhealth-header
